Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady handheld lock-off with natural micro-movement holds eye-level framing. @Image2 walks toward camera along the path in a relaxed stride, hair whipping sideways in the sea wind; she glances once toward the water and almost laughs. Linen fabric flutters gently; soft-focus surfers carry boards behind her as ocean waves roll in continuously.

ocean waves breaking on shore, light coastal breeze, distant surf. soft footsteps on concrete path, fabric and hair rustling in wind.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
